name: smollm2-135m-smoke
description: 135M smoke-test model: checks a new image, the RoCE/NCCL wiring and the gateway in about a minute. Eager, 1K context, 32 MiB KV.

source.title: SmolLM2-135M smoke test (single-a; duplicate as pp2 to test both nodes)
source.author: TwinSpark maintainers — single-a and pp2 passed on two DGX Sparks on 2026-09-28
requirements: Nothing big: ~260 MiB of weights. 9 attention heads do not split over TP2 — use pp2 for a two-node test.

A vLLM image that runs on DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121). The image hint is the local build the maintainers used (eugr/spark-vllm-docker, vllm-node-b12x); with another image, name it when you pin (Pin → image).
notes: Serves under the alias 'smoke', so it never replaces your 'default' model in clients' configs — but activating it still stops the running deployment (one deployment at a time).
